title: Grade 4 Science — Wed, Jun 11
description: Food & Nutrition — Day 3 of 5: Proteins, vitamins and deficiency diseases
subject: science

questions.question: Proteins are also called ____ foods.
questions.explanation: Proteins help in growth and repair of body tissues, so they are called body-building foods.

questions.question: Which of these is a good source of protein?
questions.explanation: Eggs are rich in high-quality protein. Other good sources include pulses, fish, meat, milk, and nuts.

questions.question: Children who do not get enough protein may develop a disease called:
questions.explanation: Kwashiorkor is caused by severe protein deficiency. Children get a swollen belly, weakness, and stunted growth.

questions.question: Vitamins are nutrients that:
options: Are needed in small amounts to keep the body healthy and prevent diseases
questions.explanation: Vitamins are micronutrients needed in small but essential amounts. They prevent deficiency diseases.

questions.question: Lack of Vitamin C in the diet causes:
questions.explanation: Scurvy is caused by Vitamin C deficiency. Symptoms include bleeding gums and slow wound healing.

questions.question: Lack of Vitamin D in the diet causes:
questions.explanation: Rickets is caused by Vitamin D (and calcium) deficiency. Bones become soft and deformed in children.

questions.question: Which vitamin is called the 'sunshine vitamin' because the body makes it from sunlight?
questions.explanation: Vitamin D is produced in the skin when exposed to sunlight. It is essential for strong bones and teeth.

questions.question: Night blindness (not seeing well in dim light) is caused by lack of:
questions.explanation: Vitamin A deficiency causes night blindness. Carrots, sweet potato, and green leafy vegetables are rich in Vitamin A.

questions.question: Which vitamin helps wounds heal and keeps gums healthy?
questions.explanation: Vitamin C (ascorbic acid) is essential for healing wounds and keeping gums and blood vessels healthy.

questions.question: Beri-beri is a disease caused by lack of:
questions.explanation: Beri-beri is caused by Vitamin B1 (thiamine) deficiency. It affects the nervous system and causes weakness.

questions.question: Anaemia is caused by lack of which mineral?
questions.explanation: Iron deficiency causes anaemia — insufficient red blood cells, leading to weakness, pale skin, and breathlessness.

questions.question: Goitre (swelling of the neck) is caused by lack of:
questions.explanation: Iodine deficiency causes goitre — swelling of the thyroid gland. Iodised salt is used to prevent this.

questions.question: Which of these foods is rich in iron?
questions.explanation: Spinach (palak), beans, jaggery (gur), and liver are rich in iron, which prevents anaemia.

questions.question: Drinking milk regularly helps prevent:
questions.explanation: Milk is rich in calcium and Vitamin D, which are essential for strong bones. It helps prevent rickets and osteoporosis.

questions.question: Which of these foods provides Vitamin C?
questions.explanation: Amla has the highest Vitamin C content of any common fruit. Oranges, lemons, and guava are also rich in Vitamin C.
